translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content: Ayic sb'itan jun b'it tic vin̈ cuchb'um yic b'it, a yamc'ab' vajxaque' sch'an̈al sc'anchaji. Sb'it jun tic vin̈aj David.

content.text: Mamin Jehová, man̈ in a tumej yed' yoval a c'ool. Man̈ ac' in yaelal ayic scot oval d'ayin.
Mamin, oc'oc val a c'ool d'ayin, yujto man̈xalaj vip svab'i. Mamin, ac'xi b'ox in c'ool yujto a in nivanil tic sluclon yuj man̈ ipal.
Te somchajnac in c'ool. A achxo Mamin Jehová, ¿b'aq'uin̈ ol ach och ved'oc?
Mamin Jehová, ochan̈ val q'uelan d'ayin, colinel yed' val a nivan vach'c'olal.
¿Tom ay mach olto ach naancotoc ayic toxo ix chami? Malaj junoc mach ol b'itan d'ayach d'a scal eb' yetchamnaquil chi'.
Ste el vip voq'ui. Man̈ jantacoc voc' d'a junjun ac'val. Sch'ayxiel in c'an̈ jolom yuj yal in sat.
Maxtzac yal-laj vilani, yujto ix mal in sat voq'ui yujn̈ej eb' ayoch ajc'olal d'ayin.
Elan̈ec d'a in tz'ey a ex to an̈ej chucal tze c'ulej. Toxo ix yab' Jehová in sic'sic'an voq'ui.
Toxo ix yab' in tevi d'ay. Toxo ix scha in lesal.
A eb' ayoch ajc'olal d'ayin, ol can eb' d'a q'uixvelal. Ton̈ej ol somchajcanel eb'. D'a junn̈ej mutz'satil ol can eb' d'a q'uixvelc'olal.
